text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Civil aviation head says the Algerian sky will be open to private companies.
- The authorities will ban smoking in public places.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia presides over campaign meeting in Algiers to urge support for referendum to amend the constitution on November 28.
- Journalists set up committee to defend press freedom.
- University teachers oppose strike suspension agreed by their union with the authorities.
- Women's rights activist Khalida Messouadi says proposed constitution endangers the future of democracy in Algeria.
